title: Audit SkillTab and skill API surface for CRUD gaps
action: Document SkillTab.tsx read-only limitations. Check if backend skill API (listSkills, loadSkill, matchSkills, getSkillChain) supports write operations. Identify which CRUD operations need new Tauri fs commands.

criteria: grep -c 'createSkill\|deleteSkill\|renameSkill\|updateSkill\|saveSkill' src/api/client.ts — baseline count for gap assessment

implementation: Read-only audit. Produce summary of: (1) current skill API functions, (2) which CRUD ops exist vs need creation, (3) skill file storage structure in skills/ directory, (4) what Tauri fs commands are needed for file-based CRUD.
